class LibraryBook(models.Model): _name = 'library.book' _description = 'Library Book'
# Many2one: ondelete is MANDATORY thinking — 'restrict' protects data, # 'cascade' deletes children, 'set null' (default) orphans the link. author_id = fields.Many2one('res.partner', string='Author', ondelete='restrict', domain="[('is_company', '=', False)]", index=True) company_id = fields.Many2one('res.company', default=lambda self: self.env.company) # One2many needs the inverse Many2one on the OTHER model (book_id below) loan_ids = fields.One2many('library.loan', 'book_id', string='Loans') loan_count = fields.Integer(compute='_compute_loan_count') # Many2many: name the relation table explicitly when two M2M link the same models tag_ids = fields.Many2many('library.tag', 'library_book_tag_rel', 'book_id', 'tag_id', string='Tags')
@api.depends('loan_ids') def _compute_loan_count(self): # batch-friendly: ONE query for the whole recordset, never search() per record counts = dict(self.env['library.loan']._read_group( [('book_id', 'in', self.ids)], ['book_id'], ['__count'])) for book in self: book.loan_count = counts.get(book, 0)
class LibraryLoan(models.Model): _name = 'library.loan' _description = 'Library Loan' _order = 'date_start desc, id desc'
book_id = fields.Many2one('library.book', required=True, ondelete='cascade', index=True) partner_id = fields.Many2one('res.partner', string='Borrower', required=True) date_start = fields.Date(default=fields.Date.context_today, required=True) # related/related-stored: read-through to the parent, no duplicate data book_author_id = fields.Many2one(related='book_id.author_id', string='Author')

from odoo import api, fields, models, tools
class LibraryLoanReport(models.Model): _name = 'library.loan.report' _description = 'Loan Analysis' _auto = False # no table: backed by the SQL view below _rec_name = 'book_id' _order = 'date_start desc'
book_id = fields.Many2one('library.book', readonly=True) partner_id = fields.Many2one('res.partner', readonly=True) date_start = fields.Date(readonly=True) nb_loans = fields.Integer(readonly=True)
def init(self): tools.drop_view_if_exists(self.env.cr, self._table) self.env.cr.execute(f""" CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {self._table} AS ( SELECT min(l.id) AS id, l.book_id, l.partner_id, l.date_start, count(*) AS nb_loans FROM library_loan l GROUP BY l.book_id, l.partner_id, l.date_start )""")
# Views for it: <list> / <graph> / <pivot>; ir.model.access.csv line with perm_read only. # NEVER write/search_read business fields "on the view model" from JS expecting a table — # aggregate in Python from the real model when the view is not enough.
